# Crime Scene Investigator Education

> Comprehensive resource for forensic science and crime scene investigation careers, offering education guides, salary data, accredited degree programs, and state-specific career pathways.

Crime Scene Investigator Education provides aspiring forensic professionals with detailed information about CSI careers, educational requirements, and salary expectations. The site features partnerships with accredited universities including Southern New Hampshire University, Arizona State University, Liberty University, and Walden University, offering various criminal justice and forensic science degree programs.

## Career Foundations

- [How to Become a Crime Scene Investigator | CSI Career Guide](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org): Main guide covering CSI education, salary data, certifications, and accredited schools.
- [What is a CSI? Crime Scene Investigator Career Guide 2026](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/what-is-a-csi): Overview of CSI role, duties, education requirements, and salary information.
- [Forensic Science Careers: 2026 Salaries & Education Guide](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/forensic-science-careers): Forensic science career overview with salary, education, and certification paths.
- [CSI Technician Job Description & Salary 2026](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/csi-technician): CSI technician job description, education requirements, and salary data.

## Education & Degree Programs

- [CSI Schools & Degree Programs | Crime Scene Investigation](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/csi-schools): Compare accredited CSI degree programs with costs and career outcomes.
- [Forensic Science Schools & Degree Programs 2026 Guide](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/forensic-science-schools): Compare FEPAC accredited forensic science programs and career paths.
- [About Us - Forensic Science Career Resources | CSI Education](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/about-us): Learn about certified CSI experts and educational guidance from forensic professionals.

## Salary & Compensation

- [CSI Salary 2026: How Much Do Crime Scene Investigators Make](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/salaries): CSI salary data by state, experience, and agency with $67,440 median.

## State-Specific Career Guides

- [CSI Career California - Requirements & Salary 2026](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/california): California CSI requirements, $96,850 median salary, and city guides.
- [CSI Jobs Colorado: Requirements, Schools & Salaries 2026](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/colorado): Colorado CSI careers with $80,790 average salary and school options.
- [CSI Schools Washington DC | Career Guide & Salaries 2026](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/district-of-columbia): Washington DC CSI careers with $86,400 salary and federal opportunities.
- [How to Become a Crime Scene Investigator in Connecticut](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/connecticut): Connecticut CSI guide with $82,350 salary and education requirements.
- [Crime Scene Investigator Arizona: Salaries & Requirements](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/arizona): Arizona CSI career opportunities with salary and training program info.
- [CSI Careers in Alabama 2026: Salary, Schools & Requirements](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/alabama): Alabama-specific CSI salary, schools, and career requirements guide.
- [Alaska CSI Education Guide 2026 | Schools & Salary Info](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/alaska): Alaska CSI programs, requirements, and salary information guide.
- [Crime Scene Investigator Arkansas - CSI Jobs & Salary](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/arkansas): Arkansas CSI requirements, salary, schools, and career paths.
- [CSI Careers in Delaware: Schools, Training & Requirements](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/delaware): Delaware CSI career paths with accredited programs and requirements.
- [CSI Jobs Florida - Salary, Schools & Requirements](https://www.crimesceneinvestigatoredu.org/florida): Florida CSI jobs with $61,070 median salary and city opportunities.
